findings.title: OWSLib expired-token expectation contradicts current WMS auth formatter
findings.impact: Latest inspected run expected HTTP 200 InvalidParameterValue while current formatter intentionally returns HTTP 401 AccessDenied. The separately adjudicated DuckDB CRS issue is tracked as NC-12.
findings.acceptance: Update to the intended authentication contract while retaining challenge and no-data assertions; DuckDB storage-versus-wire semantics remain independently tracked by NC-12.

findings.title: Interop lane omits the dedicated rendering command and discards test exit codes
findings.impact: Dedicated OpenLayers rendering runs in full CI, but the separate interop lane runs only Vitest and a different browser suite and masks nonzero test exits.
findings.acceptance: Run actual rendering in interop, preserve evidence, and return failure when any suite fails.

findings.title: Full-matrix gate trusts a public run URL without authenticating the check publisher or executed jobs
findings.impact: A controlled skipped Python job failed as intended, but appending an unrelated-app check with the expected name and the same public Actions URL changed the verdict to pass. This does not establish that a real candidate was accepted incorrectly.
findings.acceptance: Require authentic Actions app and selected check suite, exact source identity, actual required jobs and successful test steps. Retain provenance across failed-job reruns and reject unrelated publishers, skipped execution and incomplete shard coverage.

findings.title: A selected server shard can report success after executing no tests
findings.impact: The shard runner propagates the test process exit code without requiring a positive executed-test count. A successful job or step alone cannot distinguish execution from an unmatched filter.
findings.acceptance: Reject missing, empty, all-skipped and stale TRX results, enable no-match failure, preserve executed counters and digest, and verify a real unmatched filter exits nonzero.

findings.title: MCP cancellation notifications do not cancel an in-flight server request
findings.impact: The dispatcher returns without acting on notifications/cancelled. A client-side aborted ping cannot prove server cessation. Stateless clients, request-ID collisions and multi-replica delivery need explicit semantics.
findings.acceptance: Implement safe principal/session/request-scoped cancellation and prove actual server work stops while unrelated requests continue. Preserve race/cleanup safety and multi-replica guarantees; durable GP cancellation remains a separate workflow proof.

findings.title: DuckDB metadata assertions confuse published CRS84 with the physical PostGIS SRID
findings.impact: Nightly 39028726113 reports two failures because the fixture publishes CRS84 and the real client reports OGC:CRS84 while assertions insist on EPSG:4326. Other axis-order tests remain discriminating.
findings.acceptance: Assert exact CRS84 metadata and typed geometry with known longitude/latitude anchor; preserve explicit EPSG:4326 axis and projected-coordinate checks and reject wrong-CRS or swapped-coordinate controls.

findings.title: OWSLib transport probes cannot run against HTTPS despite documenting the same release lane
findings.impact: WFS/WMS/WMTS each assert scheme == http before a branch that would record HTTPS pass. HTTPS necessarily fails; compose records not-applicable and cannot establish live TLS.
findings.acceptance: Bind the actual canonical probe and advertised service URLs to the configured HTTP/HTTPS origin; reject HTTPS downgrade, unrelated origins and malformed URLs before pass. Keep HTTP compose explicitly non-TLS and retain auth/axis/render checks.
findings.catalog_gap_reason: The current governed catalog has no WFS/WMS/WMTS rows under py-owslib. This precise selector records the canonical-lane gap without attributing the same flaw to other clients or changing the denominator; registry reconciliation remains NC-05.

findings.title: OpenLayers can credit empty/overlapping pages and unfiltered WFS retrieval
findings.impact: OAPIF PAGE01 only bounds page length; PAGE02 skips empty-page comparison and allows partial overlap. An unfiltered WFS read records core filter credit. This is a canonical assertion flaw, not a reproduced runtime paging/filter defect.
findings.acceptance: Require the maintained populated fixture, expected nonempty page sizes, defined unique IDs and disjoint pages; prove empty/short/missing/duplicate/repeated/overlapping controls fail. Unfiltered WFS retrieval supplies extension-only evidence; retain genuine filtering as nonpass until independently exercised.
findings.catalog_gap_reason: No OpenLayers client_lane exists in the current catalog. Do not silently alias it to js or SDK/CITE rows or create new requirements as part of this source audit; reconcile registration under NC-05.

findings.title: OWSLib WMTS positive rendering receipt accepts a correctly sized blank PNG
findings.impact: CERT-RNDR-01, zoom sweep and second grid assert only PNG decoding/dimensions. Always-transparent positive responses satisfy these checks, while the explicit distant tile emptiness check also passes. Separate .NET red-pixel integration exists, so this is a canonical-client receipt weakness, not missing server rendering coverage.
findings.acceptance: Require authored feature/style pixels at independently computed positions for positive tiles, distinguish both grids, retain a distant blank tile and add blank/wrong-location negative controls.

findings.impact: Equality/inequality/range/LIKE/IN/BETWEEN/IS NULL/AND/OR cases do not inspect result rows. Ignored filters or universally empty successful responses can satisfy these individual cases. Other .NET predicate/state tests provide stronger independent coverage.

findings.title: GDAL WFS client filter and positive bbox checks allow over-return
findings.impact: Raw WFS filter independently checks exactly alpha, but the actual ogr2ogr -where path checks only alpha membership. Its positive -spat path checks nonempty, not returned IDs or coordinate bounds. A client ignoring the predicate can pass those checks when the raw server filter remains correct. OWSLib has stronger exact-set checks.
findings.acceptance: Assert exact GDAL output ID/name sets, known excluded rows and coordinate bounds, plus deliberately ignored-filter controls. Retain GDAL-specific evidence rather than replacing it with raw HTTP or OWSLib.
findings.ownership_note: Source implementation merged and changed content checked through server trunk e4a973997e4444e8c0f97d2cb6a62a0a5825c5e9. Current-candidate qualification remains unverified; this disposition grants no execution credit.

findings.title: SQL Server read-only refusal readback compares count but not unchanged values or primary isolation
findings.impact: Actual HTTP create/update/delete each require sanitized 501, but final SQL Server readback only compares row count. A changed attribute or fallback write into Postgres is not independently excluded by this test. No production defect was reproduced.
findings.acceptance: Retain typed/sanitized denial assertions; compare exact secondary rows/attributes and an independently seeded primary-provider same-ID sentinel before/after. Add a negative control for changed values or misrouted writes.
findings.scope_note: Existing provider depth-pack follow-up; this audit does not upgrade its release tier or change read-only provider scope. Original HTTP smoke issue2947 is closed.
findings.selector_scope: OData rows are affected-surface references, not a claim that all providers or OData clients share this weakness.

findings.title: Assisted migration recovery is not established by the generic FakeExecutor core
